question: FRUZ is related to IVXD in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, RHGP is related to ULJT. To which of the given options is ATPB related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'FRUZ is related to IVXD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee50fc307b4b9eb9cc81d434f2dd61e41d151ce67d30e3e014fcfc43f6b12dfe.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4469bc84535ff57d042e58b7c02681eec5bfb94c6e544cb63cce91bbba21d20c.png] 

For, 'RHGP is related to ULJT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5a5a6578528a4e0b6c8dcb6aa956afbbb438df9793e04b9a21c6cce0cb05acd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9b6b380913a1baa9a820686b5d6d834af0f986ea3715c4118d8503615bd078f.png] 

Similarly, for **'ATPB​'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa1eef3147605ca901f9ccf122bf8fc1e194456430447a4e1f46aa48ccac83b5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/617cc8b238a0bf5d021ab300ba38655e38547f96e04aad7f2a60914fa57bd7cd.png] 

So, 'ATPB​' will be related to **'DXSF'**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
